description: This source file implements a class and functions to transform certain scalar-vector arithmetic operations into vector-vector operations within shader code, specifically working around a NVIDIA OpenGL driver bug. It includes traversal and modification of an abstract syntax tree (AST) for shader code.

classes.name: VectorizeVectorScalarArithmeticTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the AST to identify and transform scalar-vector arithmetic operations into vector-vector operations.

methods.name: Vectorize
methods.description: Converts a scalar node into a vector constructor of a specified type.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Handles binary operations during AST traversal, transforming scalar operations to vector operations where applicable.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Handles aggregate nodes, transforming scalar binary expressions inside vector constructors.

methods.name: replaceMathInsideConstructor
methods.description: Replaces scalar binary operations inside vector constructor nodes with vectorized versions.

methods.name: replaceAssignInsideConstructor
methods.description: Transforms scalar assignment operations inside vector constructors into a sequence of vector operations with temporary variables.

methods.name: VectorizeVectorScalarArithmetic
methods.description: Main function that applies the traversal and transformation to the AST to vectorize scalar arithmetic operations.
